why: One registry for what this tree is checked with and by what, so the same fact stops living on four sides of the repository. Every tool pin is stated once here and asserted against the file that actually uses it; every make target is a gate or is not, with the question it answers; every CI job is named. tests/Architecture/ToolchainRegistryContractTest.php fails on any drift in either direction, so a new gate, a new job or a version bump cannot happen silently. Read by `make gates`.

tools.name: mago
tools.why: lint and guard are gates, analyze is a reading, format is excluded; see docs/mago-evaluation.md

tools.name: lekalo
tools.why: the model gate; version and checksum must match nativa-minimal's install step, so the two projects cannot validate against different binaries

tools.name: clickhouse
tools.why: the optional smoke's server: the release tarball is cached and checksum-verified, so the engine the smoke measures is a pinned one and not whatever master built that day
